decisions.state_note: o000: visible window around x120–183, y50–113 shows pale mottled material without a clear contour; no detections. Class unresolved.
o001: window x120–183, y18–81 shows dark upper area and pale material below a roughly horizontal transition near y40, dipping near the right edge; no detections. Class unresolved.
o002: window x88–151, y18–81 shows dark background above and left of pale material, with near-vertical bright-right boundary around x119, y41–76; detector agrees. Shape remains unresolved.

o003: window x88–151, y50–113 shows pale mottled material right of a dark boundary that curves leftward from about x119 at y63 to x94 at y109. Detector supports its upper near-vertical segment. Class unresolved.
o004: window x88–151, y82–145 shows pale mottled material; dark upper-left region meets a sloping boundary reaching the left edge near y120. No detections; class unresolved.
o005: window x88–151, y114–177 shows pale mottled material and a narrow bright lower ridge near x109–136, y170 with darker pixels below, also detected. Possible footwear outline remains unresolved.

o006: window x88–151, y146–209 shows pale material above a stepped/sloping lower boundary near y169–185 and black below. Two detected bright rim segments match this boundary. Footwear is a hypothesis; right-side structure remains unseen.

o007: window x120–183, y146–209 shows pale material above a bright sloping lower edge; dark below, with a step near x160 from y176 to y191 and pale extension to its right. Detected ridges and vertical transition match these local features. Footwear hypothesis remains unresolved.

o008: window x120–183, y114–177 shows pale mottled material with a narrow horizontal bright ridge near x137–165, y163 and dark pixels beneath; detector matches. Right outer contour remains unknown; footwear remains a hypothesis.
o009: window x152–215, y114–177 shows pale mottled material across most of the view and a small dark patch at its lower-left edge; no detections. Right contour and overall shape remain unresolved.

o010: window x152–215, y82–145 shows pale mottled material, with a narrow dark region at the upper-right beside a near-vertical bright edge around x211. No detections. Footwear remains a hypothesis; upper-right contour needs clarification.
o011: window x152–215, y50–113 shows pale mottled material with a narrow dark region beside its right edge around x212; no detections. Upper contour remains unseen in this view.

o012: window x152–215, y18–81 shows dark area above pale material, with an uneven upper transition near y40–48 and a small dark dip near x174. No detections. Tall pale right-side region could support an ankle-boot hypothesis; left extent remains unknown.

o013: window x120–183, y18–81 shows black above pale material, with upper boundary near y40 and a dark dip around x174. No detections. This repeats previously viewed upper material; ankle boot remains a hypothesis.

o014: window x88–151, y18–81 repeats black above/left of pale material, with a near-vertical boundary around x119, y41–76 matching the detector. Leftward lower extent remains unknown; ankle boot is a hypothesis.

o015: x88–151, y50–113 shows pale mottled material right of a boundary curving leftward toward y110; detected vertical contrast near (119,63) matches pixels. Left extent remains unknown; ankle boot is a hypothesis.

o016: window x56–119, y50–113 is mostly dark, with pale material at the right edge widening leftward near the bottom. Detector marks a near-vertical bright-right transition around (115,64). Left lower extent remains unknown.

o017: window x56–119, y82–145 shows dark above-left and pale mottled material below-right of a curved boundary descending leftward from about (110,85) to (57,140). No detections. Ankle boot remains a hypothesis; lower-left outline needs inspection.

o018: window x56–119, y114–177 shows pale mottled material below-right of a boundary sloping from about (87,115) to (57,143), with dark above-left. No detections. Ankle boot remains a hypothesis; far-left lower contour is unobserved.

o019: window x24–87, y114–177 shows dark above a curved boundary rising rightward, with pale textured material below; no detections. Together with the previously observed tall right region and stepped lower rim, the outline supports ankle boot.
